integrity: Integral homotopy proof uses explicit simplicial pairs, cone/ball attachment and retraction, not extrapolation from finite checks.
scientific_limitations: Even rim length n=2m>=4 and alternating spoke directions only; no arbitrary wheel-orientation classification. Finite tests cover n=4,6,8,10; arbitrary n follows from the proof. Indexed-source overlap comparison cannot prove universal priority.
title: Mixed-dimensional sphere wedges for alternating-spoke directed wheels
